description_en: Submit a screenshot job. Media Processing Service (MPS) will then take screenshots and generate a sprite image from the input file
description_zh: 提交截图作业。调用本接口之后媒体处理MPS会对输入文件进行截图和拼图
name: SubmitSnapshotJob

parameters.help_en:
The job input. For more information, see [Input](~~29253#section-f3p-d24-y2b~~).

In ApsaraVideo for Media Processing (MPS) APIs, you must https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html the value of `Object` in UTF-8.

The OSS region must be the same as the MPS region
parameters.help_zh:
作业输入。详细说明请参见[Input详情](~~29253#section-f3p-d24-y2b~~)。

在媒体处理API中，Object必须经过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html（基于UTF-8编码）后使用。
OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The snapshot configurations. For more information, see [SnapshotConfig](~~29253#section-zh2-324-y2b~~)
parameters.help_zh: 截图配置。详细说明，请参见[SnapshotConfig参数详情](~~29253#section-zh2-324-y2b~~)
parameters.name: snapshot_config

parameters.help_en: The custom data. The value can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-), but cannot start with a special character. The value can be up to 1,024 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据。支持中英文、数字、短划线（-），不能以特殊字符开头，最大长度1024个字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the MPS queue. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29197.html.

You can view or create MPS queues in the MPS console (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) by choosing Global Settings > Pipelines.

To receive asynchronous notifications, you must bind a Message Service (MNS) queue to the MPS queue. For more information, see <props="china">Receive message notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">Receive message notifications (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
管道ID，详细说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29197.html。

可选值：可以通过MPS控制台 (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) > 全局设置 > 管道查询和创建管道。
如果需要异步通知，请为管道绑定MNS消息，具体请参见<props="china">接收消息通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">接收消息通知 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>
parameters.name: pipeline_id

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned only when the job status is Fail
Code.description_zh: 分析失败时错误码。若成功则不返回此参数

Count.description_en: The total number of captured snapshots

CreationTime.description_en: The time the job was created

Id.description_en: The ID of the snapshot job

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket that contains the input file

Location.description_en: The data center of the input OSS bucket
Location.description_zh: 输入OSS Bucket所在数据中心（OSS Location）

Object.description_en: The name of the input OSS object

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role. Format: `acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName`

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The result of the MNS notification sent to the user upon job completion
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成的结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code, returned only if the MNS notification fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败时错误码。若成功则不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message, returned only if the MNS notification fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 失败时错误信息。若成功则不返回此参数
ErrorMessage.example: The resource operated InputFile is bad

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the MNS message. This parameter is returned only on successful notification
MessageId.description_zh: 成功时消息ID。若失败则不返回此参数

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only if the job fails
Message.description_zh: 分析失败时错误信息。若成功则不返回此参数
Message.example: The resource operated InputFile is bad

FrameType.description_en:
The type of frames to capture. Default value: normal. Valid values:

normal: normal frames.

intra: I-frames (keyframes).

If this parameter is set to `intra`, only keyframes are captured. If a specified time point is not a keyframe, the system uses the nearest keyframe. Capturing keyframes is typically faster than capturing normal frames
FrameType.description_zh:
截图类型。默认值：normal。可取值：
normal：普通帧。
intra：I帧（关键帧）。

如果请求参数中将FrameType参数设置为I帧（关键帧），将只截取关键帧。如果指定的时间节点为非关键帧，则就近选取关键帧。在同等截图规则下，关键帧截图比普通帧截图速度快

Height.description_en: The height of the output snapshot

Interval.description_en:
The interval for capturing a sequence of snapshots.

The value must be greater than 0.

Unit: seconds.

Default value: 10
Interval.description_zh:
截图间隔时间。

若指定则表示序列截图，且值大于0。
单位：秒。
默认值：10

Num.description_en: The number of snapshots to capture in a sequence
Num.description_zh: 截图数量。若指定则表示序列截图

OutputFile.description_en: The OSS configuration for the output snapshot

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket for the output file
Bucket.description_zh: 截图输出文件所在OSS Bucket

Location.description_en: The data center of the output OSS bucket
Location.description_zh: 截图输出OSS Bucket所在数据中心（OSS Location）

Object.description_en: The name of the output OSS object

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role. Format: `acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName`

CellHeight.description_en: The height of an individual image in the tiled output. Defaults to the height of the output snapshot
CellHeight.description_zh: 单图片高度。默认截图输出分辨率高度

CellSelStep.description_en: The step for selecting individual images to include in the tiled output

CellWidth.description_en: The width of an individual image in the tiled output. Defaults to the width of the output snapshot
CellWidth.description_zh: 单图片宽度。默认截图输出分辨率宽度

Color.description_en:
The background color.

Default value: black.

Valid values: color keyword or random.

Color keywords can be specified in three formats. For example, to specify black, you can use `Black`, `black`, or `#000000`
Color.description_zh:
背景颜色。
默认：black。
可取值范围：颜色关键字，random。

其中颜色关键字支持三种格式，比如黑色，支持Black，black，#000000

Columns.description_en: The number of columns in the tiled image. Default value: 10

IsKeepCellPic.description_en:
Specifies whether to keep the individual snapshots. Valid values:

true: Keeps the individual snapshots.

false: Deletes the individual snapshots.

Default value: true
IsKeepCellPic.description_zh:
是否保留单图片。可取值：

true：保留。

false：不保留。

默认：true

Lines.description_en: The number of rows in the tiled image. Default value: 10

Margin.description_en:
The width of the outer margin for the tiled image.

Default value: 0.

Unit: pixels
Margin.description_zh:
外框宽度。

默认：0。

单位：px

Padding.description_en:
The padding between images.

Default value: 0.

Unit: pixels
Padding.description_zh:
图片间距。

默认：0。

单位：px

TileOutputFile.description_en: The OSS configuration for the output tiled image
TileOutputFile.description_zh: 拼图任务大图的输出OSS配置

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket for the output file

Location.description_en: The data center of the output OSS bucket
Location.description_zh: 输出OSS Bucket所在数据中心（OSS Location）

Object.description_en: The name of the output OSS object

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role. Format: `acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName`

Time.description_en: The snapshot start time. Unit: milliseconds
Time.description_zh: 截图开始时间。单位：毫秒

Width.description_en: The width of the output snapshot

State.description_en:
The state of the snapshot job. Valid values:

Submitted: The job has been submitted.

Snapshotting: The snapshot job is in progress.

Success: The job was successful.

Fail: The job failed
State.description_zh:
截图状态。取值：
Submitted：已提交。
Snapshoting：截图中。

Success：截图成功。

Fail：截图失败
